name: meshpoint
description: Background-grid mesh points — the fixed computational grid through which material points move. Use to inspect the grid resolution and extent relative to the material-point body.

sub_items.name: label
sub_items.description: Categorical colouring of grid nodes. 'label' itself takes no argument; it opens a sub-context whose keywords are NOT offered at the item's top level.
verification: state -- MPoint3D 9.7; each sub-keyword accepted after 'label', rejected before it

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Do NOT probe with a bogus token: 'plot item create <type> zzbogus' creates the item and then reports 'Unused extra parameter' without ever enumerating. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MPoint 3D 9.

The split is systematic rather than per-item: 'clip', 'cut', 'quality' and 'transparency' are 3D rendering concepts and are absent from every MPoint item type in 2D, while 'spheres' is how 2D draws point entities and appears only on the point items ('mpoint', 'mpoint-hybrid', 'meshpoint'), not the vector ones. 'mpoint-tensor' has an identical keyword set in both.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Bare switch that turns on categorical colouring of grid nodes and opens a sub-context: 'label extra <1..128>', 'label fixity', 'label group <string>', 'label uniform'. Unlike mpoint-hybrid's 'label', it takes no string of its own -- 'label "name"' is rejected.

keywords.description: Draw across the whole model (ignore per-plot clipping).
keywords.name: global

keywords.description: Filter which entities are drawn using range elements (see references/range-elements).
keywords.name: range

keywords.description: Configure the contour colour map (ranges, intervals, colours).
keywords.name: map

keywords.description: Apply a 3D cutting plane to the item.

keywords.name: transparency
